messages:
Noah (Design): Hey all  quick review of the API Keys page updates. I moved revoke out of the kebab into a "danger" panel at the bottom. Pushed new frames to Figma: compact rotate modal + optional overlap toggle. Thoughts?

Priya (PM): nice. main ask from support: new key shown after rotate needs a clearer CTA to copy and guidance that it's shown only once. avoid long paragraphs.

Tomas (Eng): agree on copy. also implementation note: the existing copy button triggers a toast which is not accessible via keyboard focus. We should ensure copy is focusable and the toast has role=alert.

Lena (A11y): accessibility checklist: modal uses role=dialog, focus trap enabled, title announced via aria-labelledby, long text hidden with aria-expanded toggle. For the 'shown only once' secret, use visually-hidden text "New key value, shown one time" and make the copy button `aria-describedby` that label.

Noah (Design): copy suggestion for rotate success area: "New key generated  copy it now. This value will only be shown once." small scope summary pills below with link to details.

Priya (PM): for empty state, product prefers a single primary CTA "Create API key" and a subtle "See examples" link that opens a panel with 3 micro-templates (client read-only, server full, embed limited). keep templates compact.

Tomas (Eng): overlap toggle implementation: default off. If enabled, backend will allow both keys for 30 minutes and we surface an expiry time + countdown. we'll emit an event so UI can show time-left. UI should also surface absolute end time for accessibility.

Lena (A11y): countdown must not rely solely on color. include icon + text e.g., "Overlap active  ends at 17:42 UTC" and aria-live="polite" for progressive updates. tooltips must use role=tooltip and be keyboard dismissible.

Noah (Design): revoke modal change: headline "Permanently revoke key" and single-sentence subcopy "This will immediately stop any clients using the key." Add required checkbox "I understand this will stop traffic" before enabling revoke.

Priya (PM): good. Also ask: should rotate modal expose the overlap option as a checkbox or a secondary step? some customers are confused by extra toggles.

Tomas (Eng): prefer a single-step checkbox inline with a small help icon. If enabled, show countdown after rotate. Less friction.

Lena (A11y): ensure checkbox label is explicit and keyboard reachable. Announce change in state to screen readers when overlap is toggled.

Noah (Design): action items: I'll tighten copy in Figma, show pill summary for scopes in create flow, and add the danger zone in the detail view.

Priya (PM): I'll draft the final microcopy for rotate/revoke and the empty state samples and post here.

deploy-bot: Staging deploy scheduled 2026-03-24T17:00Z  contains keys CSS updates.

Noah (Design): thanks everyone  will tag when mocks are ready for final a11y pass. :thumbsup:
